title: Hosea Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Hosea 2: the charge against the mother, the lovers she followed, and the promise to allure her into the wilderness.

questions.text: What reason is given for contending with the mother?
questions.explanation: The text says to contend with her because she is not my wife, neither am I her husband, and she is to put away her prostitution and her adulteries.

answers.text: She is not my wife, neither am I her husband
She has left her children without bread
She has gone up to the house of the king
She has sold her vineyards to strangers

questions.text: What did the mother say her lovers give her?
questions.explanation: She said she would go after her lovers, who give her her bread and her water, her wool and her flax, her oil and her drink.

answers.text: Her silver, gold, jewels and earrings
Her grain, new wine, honey and milk
Her bread, water, wool, flax, oil and drink
Her vines, fig trees, oaks and poplars

questions.text: With what does Yahweh say he will hedge up her way?
questions.explanation: The verse says he will hedge up her way with thorns and build a wall against her, so that she cannot find her way.

answers.text: With fire
With thorns
With a flood of water
With a thick cloud

questions.text: What did she not know, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says she did not know that he gave her the grain, the new wine and the oil, and multiplied silver and gold to her, which they used for Baal.

answers.text: That her lovers had already left the land
That her children had turned back to him
That her feasts had been forgotten
That he gave her the grain, the new wine and the oil

questions.text: Which of her celebrations does Yahweh say he will cause to cease?
questions.explanation: The verse says he will cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths and all her solemn assemblies.

answers.text: Her feasts, new moons, Sabbaths and solemn assemblies
Her weddings, dances, songs and harvest songs
Her sacrifices, incense, oaths and vows
Her markets, fairs, journeys and caravans

questions.text: Where does Yahweh say he will bring her when he allures her?
questions.explanation: The verse says he will allure her, bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.

answers.text: Into the land of Egypt
Into the valley of Jezreel
Into the wilderness
Into the house of her first husband

questions.text: Which valley is to be given for a door of hope?
questions.explanation: The verse says he will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope.

answers.text: The valley of Jezreel
The valley of Achor
The valley of Gibeah
The valley of the Baals

questions.text: What will she call him in that day, and what will she no longer call him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that in that day she will call him my husband, and will no longer call him my master.

answers.text: My shepherd, and no longer my judge
My father, and no longer my king
My maker, and no longer my lover
My husband, and no longer my master

questions.text: In what does Yahweh say he will betroth her to himself?
questions.explanation: The verses say he will betroth her to himself forever in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, in compassion and in faithfulness.

answers.text: In righteousness, justice, loving kindness, compassion and faithfulness
In silver, gold, grain, new wine and the oil of the land
In feasts, new moons, Sabbaths and solemn assemblies
In fear, trembling, mourning, fasting and sackcloth

questions.text: What will Yahweh say to those who were not his people, in the last verse?
questions.explanation: The verse says he will tell those who were not his people, you are my people, and they will say, my God.

answers.text: You are not my people
You are the sons of Baal
You are my people
You are strangers in the land
